title: [Bug]: Cannot use async Agents with LiteLLM and tools
body:
### Bug Description

llama-index 0.12.25

Error in step 'run_agent_step': 'LiteLLM' object has no attribute 'astream_chat_with_tools'


https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/main/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/agent/workflow/function_agent.py references the function astream_chat_with_tools, but it doesn't seem to exist in any LLM object (even if in my case, I want to run it with a LiteLLM model)

### Version

0.12.25

### Steps to Reproduce

Take
https://github.com/run-llama/python-agents-tutorial/blob/main/6_multi_agent.py
replace llm by:
llm = LiteLLM(model="XXX", base_url="YYY", api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
run...

### Relevant Logs/Tracbacks

```shell
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/llama_index/core/workflow/context.py", line 500, in _step_worker
    new_ev = await instrumented_step(**kwargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/llama_index/core/instrumentation/dispatcher.py", line 368, in async_wrapper
    result = await func(*args, **kwargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/llama_index/core/agent/workflow/multi_agent_workflow.py", line 329, in run_agent_step
    agent_output = await agent.take_step(
                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/llama_index/core/agent/workflow/function_agent.py", line 42, in take_step
    response = await self.llm.astream_chat_with_tools(  # type: ignore
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/main.py", line 891, in __getattr__
    raise AttributeError(f'{type(self).__name__!r} object has no attribute {item!r}')
AttributeError: 'LiteLLM' object has no attribute 'astream_chat_with_tools'

The above exception was the direct cause of the following exception:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.12.8-linux-x86_64-gnu/lib/python3.12/asyncio/events.py", line 88, in _run
    self._context.run(self._callback, *self._args)
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/llama_index/core/instrumentation/dispatcher.py", line 286, in handle_future_result
    raise exception
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/llama_index/core/workflow/workflow.py", line 394, in _run_workflow
    raise exception_raised
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/llama_index/core/workflow/context.py", line 508, in _step_worker
    raise WorkflowRuntimeError(
llama_index.core.workflow.errors.WorkflowRuntimeError: Error in step 'run_agent_step': 'LiteLLM' object has no attribute 'astream_chat_with_tools'
```

Yes.

This is an agent issue because it involves an LLM provider integration (LiteLLM), agent workflow execution, and tool invocation (async chat with tools). The error arises from missing functionality in the LLM object required for agent-tool interaction. This fits the "Incompatibility with LLM providers" and "Tool-related issues" categories.
